name: [Portal] Medailonek publication flow + CRM review (BE + CRM)
description:
### Summary

This task adds the control point between a partner writing their medailonek and that text appearing on partneri.shoptet.cz and doplnky.shoptet.cz. The medailonek is the partner's public profile card, and in the new Partner Portal agencies, freelancers, affiliate partners and addon developers edit it themselves, so Shoptet needs a way to review what changes. The task implements the per-language state transitions: submit moves a draft to pending, approve publishes it and atomically replaces the previously approved version, and reject returns it with a reason the partner can see. A configuration switch chooses between requiring approval before publication and publishing immediately with a later review, because the decision is still open. It also adds a CRM listing where the Partnership team sees pending or recently published changes with a diff against the last approved text, plus e-mail notifications on submit and reject. Automated content checks such as profanity filtering are out of scope. It depends on the partner profile domain layer and unblocks the publish button in the edit screen.

### Why?

A partner-written medailonek goes public on partneri.shoptet.cz and doplnky.shoptet.cz, so Shoptet needs a control point. The MVP scope leaves two variants open (wiki Q2): publish immediately with ex-post check, or pending → approval by Partnership. Both need the same backbone: a per-language text state machine (draft → pending → approved / rejected) already sketched in `partner_lng.status`, a CRM place where Partnership sees what changed, and notifications. Without this task the edit screen () can only save drafts.

### What?

Backend transitions for per-language medailonek text: submit (draft → pending), approve (pending → approved, stamps approver and time, replaces the previous approved row), reject (pending → rejected with a reason visible to the partner). A configuration switch selects the mode, so one implementation serves both Q2 variants. A CRM listing "Medailonek changes" (pending or recently published, per language, diff against the last approved text) with approve/reject actions. E-mail to Partnership on submit and to the partner on reject. Content checks (profanity etc.) are out of this task; no mechanism is chosen yet.

### Acceptance Criteria

Commands submit / approve / reject validate the allowed transition per language and are unit-tested

Approve replaces the previous approved row for that language atomically; the public read side never sees a half-updated profile

Mode switch: "pending → approval" or "publish immediately + ex-post review"; in the second mode submit auto-approves and the CRM listing shows the text as "published, unreviewed"

CRM listing shows partner, language, submitted at, and a diff against the last approved text; approve and reject gated to the Partnership role

Reject requires a reason; the partner sees it in the portal and the rejected text stays editable as a draft

E-mail to Partnership on submit (per mode) and to the partner's contact e-mail on reject, in CZ/SK/HU

Integration tests cover draft → pending → approved and draft → pending → rejected → resubmit; PHPStan level 10

### Open questions

- Wiki Q2: which mode ships in the MVP? Decided with Partnership; proposed default pending → approval.
- Inappropriate-content check (profanity): no mechanism chosen. Out of scope here; separate task if wanted.
- `partner_lng` unique key (partnerId, language, status) allows one row per status, so a rejected text and a new draft cannot coexist. Drop the rejected row on resubmit, or add a history table? Decide before implementation.

- State enum already exists: `cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Domain/Partner/Enum/PartnerTextStatus.php` (draft, pendingApproval, approved, rejected); `partner_lng.approvedById → admin_users`, `approvedAt` (`database/schema/st_crm.sql` L2533).
- Approval precedent to mirror, not reuse: `st_api.service_approval_request` + `cms/packages/Connectors/Model/ApiPartner.php:898` (approvedService) / `:941` (pendingService); notification e-mails `cms/packages/Information/Model/NewPartnerForApproval.php`, `NewAddonForApproval.php`.
- CRM has no screen editing partner profile text today; nearest home is `crm/admin/controllers/PartnerDetailController.php` or a new listing next to `AdminPartnersController.php`. CRM controllers are Smarty.
- Text-history precedent if a history table is chosen: `st_crm.services_history`.
